03 — The Studio

A calm spot in Midtown.

Our light, airy salon sits on Center Street — easy to reach and easy to settle into. Long opening hours mean you can fit in your pampering, however busy your week gets.

We're highly trained in all things nails, so you're in safe, trustworthy hands from your first file to your final coat.

  • Parking available
